mapper.select: SELECT p.*, b.name AS brand_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, brand_id, category, price, description, image_url, status, merchant_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{brandId}, #{category}, #{price}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{status}, #{merchantId})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM product WHERE category IS NOT NULL ORDER BY category
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET view_count = COALESCE(view_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY (COALESCE(sales_count, 0) * 3 + COALESCE(view_count, 0)) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
